artifact.name: Z-Girl v3.18 Human-Centered Commercial Foundation RC2

review.evaluator: Greene Media Studio governed production review
review.notes: Rebuilt the v3.18 human-centered/commercial candidate from current production main after the public Demo security hotfixes. External Unsplash photography is replaced by five Greene-controlled original vector human scenes. Public metered AI, live supporter handoffs, and restricted operational access remain governed by current main middleware.

ai_uses.purpose: Accelerate original human-centered scene production and release-candidate reconciliation without weakening privacy, role boundaries, or public Demo controls
ai_uses.user_or_production_value: Makes the commercial story visually human and market-ready while eliminating third-party photo provenance as a release blocker
ai_uses.human_oversight: Owner retains final public-release approval; human supporters retain real-world authority; participant sharing stays controlled
ai_uses.provenance: Original SVG geometry and application integration produced within lgreene2/zgirl-hero-coach under Greene Media Studio direction

automation.no_additional_automation_rationale: Customer entitlements, commission schedules, reseller economics, fundraising activation, and public release remain governance decisions rather than automatic actions.

evidence: Human-centered commercial surfaces use a consistent original visual language
Athlete, faith, institutional, family, and partner scenes reinforce the real-person support model
AI-assisted production removed the final image-rights dependency without introducing an external media platform as source of truth
Visuals reinforce trusted human support and participant control rather than professional substitution
RC is based on current protected main rather than the conflicted pre-hotfix branch
Local SVGs remove external image-host dependency
All scenes include descriptive alt text and embedded SVG title/description metadata
Existing responsive application structure is retained
Human support remains a contextual layer around the existing Hero Within experience
Public Demo security controls are inherited from current main
No participant reflection data is added to commercial marketing surfaces

exceptions: This RC does not activate public commercial release, paid checkout changes, affiliate commissions, reseller discounts, public fundraising claims, institutional customer entitlements, or new live-data access. Explicit owner approval is required before merge/release.
